context:
Guard the heavy path on file presence; always run a cheap corpus contract.
Delegate npm/Playwright to the Results Explorer's own entrypoint so UAT calls
it rather than reimplementing it. Make docs.yml dormancy intentional.
description:
Outcome of a 4-round adversarial architecture review of the UAT layer. This
is the critic's single highest-priority item: the ONLY live, verifiable
defect (as opposed to a wording/charter dispute).

tests/uat/phases/explorer_smoke.py is present on origin/main and shells out to
`_project/scripts/explorer_publish.py build` and results-explorer/ scripts —
but BOTH _project/scripts/explorer_publish.py AND results-explorer/ are ABSENT
from origin/main (verified). So main carries a release-gate phase that is
structurally incapable of passing on a clean main checkout: it is dead /
false-gating.

The phase also re-issues npm ci / npm run build / playwright
(explorer_smoke.py:222-226), duplicating the Results Explorer's own CI
(.github/workflows/results-explorer-browser.yml).

IMPORTANT framing: explorer smoke IS chartered by the spec
(_project/specs/uat-framework.md:38,102,128,297-299,418,445). This is a
release-HYGIENE problem, not a charter problem. Do not delete the capability;
make it safe when the explorer is absent and stop owning browser mechanics.

anti_patterns.why: it is chartered; make it presence-aware

anti_patterns.dont: hard-fail when the explorer is absent

deferrals.reason: Hard-gating requires the explorer + publish pipeline to be present on the release branch (see [[uat-charter-visibility-on-main]]).
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: Condition (explorer+publish pipeline present on release branch) not yet met; remediate-explorer-deploy-path-reconciliation (open) confirms explorer is still stripped from release curation.
deferrals.summary: Re-enable full explorer smoke as a hard release gate once the explorer ships to the target branch

preserves.behavior: Packaged-bundle corpus contract is still validated on every run (minimal check)
When the explorer IS present, the full build + Playwright smoke still runs and gates as before

prior_art.concept: .github/workflows/results-explorer-browser.yml — reuse as the browser-test owner; UAT should not copy its npm/Playwright mechanics
results-explorer/scripts/serve-browser-tests.mjs — reuse/extend only if a thin delegated entrypoint is needed when the explorer is present
tests/uat/phases/explorer_smoke.py — preserve the UAT phase wrapper but reduce it to corpus contract + delegation

scope_rules.path_glob: results-explorer/ (entrypoint UAT calls — only if delegation requires a thin command)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest -k 'explorer_smoke and (skip or guard)' -q
verifications.description: Clean main checkout runs UAT without false-gating on absent explorer files
verifications.expected: phase skips-with-reason when explorer files absent; no hard failure

verifications.description: Minimal corpus-contract check runs regardless of explorer presence
verifications.expected: corpus contract validated; passes/fails on bundle shape, not Node availability
